title: Black Walnut and Cherry Strudel
description: This black walnut and cherry strudel recipe, which makes two strudels using puff pastry, is a decadent dessert worth the time and effort it takes!
ingredients: 2 teaspoons milk, or more as needed

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C).
For the strudel, mix egg and water together in a bowl. Set aside.
Beat cream cheese, sugar, and lemon juice together in another bowl with an electric mixer until smooth and fluffy.

Roll each pastry sheet into a 12x16-inch rectangle. Spread 1/2 of the cream cheese mixture down the center of a long side of each rectangle, leaving a 1-inch border at the top and bottom. Top each cream cheese layer with 1/2 of the cherries and 1/2 of the walnuts.

Fold opposite long ends of each pastry sheet over filling, brushing edges with reserved egg mixture to seal. Tuck short ends underneath, and place seam-side down on a baking sheet. Make several diagonal cuts over strudels to vent filling. Brush the tops of strudels with egg wash.
Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, about 35 minutes. Cool strudels on baking sheet set on a wire rack, at least 30 minutes.
For the glaze, whisk confectioners' sugar, milk, and vanilla extract together in a bowl until desired thickness. Drizzle over strudels.
